sloka: वाली व्यापातयाञ्चक्रे ननर्द च महास्वनम् ।श्रोत्राभ्यामथ रक्तं तु तस्य सुस्राव पात्यतः ॥४-११-४१॥।।
transliteration: vālī vyāpātayāñcakre nanarda ca mahāsvanam ।śrotrābhyāmatha raktaṁ tu tasya susrāva pātyataḥ ॥4-11-41॥।।

translations.english: 'Vali whirled him round and round and threw him downroaring. Blood flowed from Dundubhi's ears.
